Definition
[Fréchet differentiability] 1. ch8:8.5.1-def-1\group Critical Point Theory We say $I$ is differentiable at $u \in H$ if there exists $v \in H$ such that \[ I[w] = I[u] + (v, w - u) + o(\| w - u\| ) \quad (w \in H). \tag {1} \] The element $v$, if it exists, is unique. We then write $I'[u] = v$.
